Project Title

Cross-Domain Data Normalization and Dimensionality Reduction Pipeline using Pandas, Scikit-learn, and t-SNE/UMAP
📁 cross_domain_dim_reduction_pipeline.py
🆔 Reference: ai-ml-ds-EbV9pLyZfWq

Short Description

This project presents an advanced pipeline for preprocessing and reducing the dimensionality of heterogeneous datasets. It integrates robust data normalization techniques and leverages both linear (PCA) and non-linear (t-SNE, UMAP) dimensionality reduction methods to transform complex, high-dimensional data into lower-dimensional representations suitable for visualization and further analysis.

Example Inputs & Expected Outputs

Input:

data: pd.DataFrame = fetch_openml("adult", version=2, as_frame=True).frame.sample(1000, random_state=42)
pipeline: CrossDomainPipeline = CrossDomainPipeline(reducer='umap')
transformed_data: np.ndarray = pipeline.fit_transform(data.drop(columns=['class']))

Output:

A 2D numpy array of shape (1000, 2) representing the reduced dimensional space.

  • Feature Engineering
  • Data Visualization
  • Cross-Domain Data Integration([arXiv][1])

Final Product Description

A modular, scalable pipeline capable of handling diverse datasets, performing robust normalization, and reducing dimensionality for visualization and further machine learning tasks. The pipeline is designed with flexibility in mind, allowing for easy integration into existing ML workflows.

Key Learnings & Research Areas

  • Dimensionality Reduction Techniques (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)
  • Data Normalization Strategies
  • Pipeline Design Patterns
  • Cross-Domain Data Handling
  • Visualization of High-Dimensional Data([Built In][5], [DataCamp][6])

Where to Go From Here

  • Incorporate deep learning-based autoencoders for dimensionality reduction.
  • Extend the pipeline to handle time-series and multimodal data.
  • Integrate with real-time data processing frameworks for streaming data.
  • Develop a user-friendly interface for non-technical stakeholders.
